correctness.rationale: All quantifiers fixed: coprime p,q>1, reduced complex SL2 representation variety, singular homology over integers. Known full-text geometry gives closed components SL2 and g disjoint QxQ intersecting in two graphs per component. Semialgebraic triangulation supplies cofibrations; Q retracts S2, SL2 retracts S3, U→−U is antipodal of degree −1 on H2. Direct calculation gives each H2-inclusion block [[1,1],[1,-1]] with Smith factors (1,2); its kernel vanishes and its cokernel Z/2. Exact Mayer–Vietoris yields H0=H3=Z, H1=H4=Z^g, H2=(Z/2)^g and zero higher. H0 incidence image is primitive and rank g. Exact SymPy replay from verify.py reported VERIFY_OK for ten pairs; checks are illustrative, not an infinite proof.
